svg.text: For an ordinary directory where the condition does not hold, no swap happens and it moves one directory up within the same mount.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: The test does not use the i-node number. tiny-fs's root being ino 1 is this FS's own rule, and ext4's root is ino 2.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: The reverse is the same. Descending into /mnt/tiny-fs switches over to tiny-fs's root, not ext4's dirent.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: What joins tree to tree is not the FS but this record in the kernel.
